newLayers.name: Core Utilities
newLayers.description: General purpose helpers used all over core: the Utils object (class loading, temp directories, file fetching, host names, size and time parsing, call sites, process execution, resource management helpers), clocks, byte buffer streams, class loaders for user jars, lazy value helpers, bounded priority queues, dependency resolution for jars and files, and small command line helpers.

tour.title: Utils and small helpers
tour.description: Most of core leans on a few shared helpers. Utils collects hundreds of small functions: loading classes with the right class loader, creating and deleting temp directories, fetching files and archives, resolving host names, parsing sizes and time strings, finding the user call site of an RDD operation and running external commands. Alongside it are Clock implementations for testable time, byte buffer streams, class loaders that let user jars override Spark's, and DependencyUtils which resolves the jars and files given to spark-submit.
